items.title_cn: 血浆宏基因组二代测序指导伴早期发热的急性坏死性胰腺炎抗生素治疗的潜力：一项前瞻性多中心队列研究
items.title_en: Potential of plasma metagenomic next-generation sequencing to guide antibiotic therapy in acute necrotizing pancreatitis with early fever: a prospective multicenter cohort study
items.abstract_cn: 急性坏死性胰腺炎（ANP）发热患者中不加区分的抗生素使用仍然普遍，尤其是在早期阶段。宏基因组下一代测序（mNGS）已显示出对感染性胰腺坏死（IPN）的诊断价值，并可能为抗菌治疗提供指导手段。我们旨在探讨mNGS是否能够潜在改善以早期发热就诊的ANP患者抗生素使用的合理性。这项前瞻性多中心队列研究在中国五家医院开展，纳入症状发作两周内出现发热的ANP患者。抗生素敏感性依据当地微生物实验室报告进行判定。由于在实际临床过程中mNGS结果未向治疗团队披露，我们通过回顾性模拟，依据华大基因中国抗菌药物使用卡中的预设标准，评估了mNGS对减少不合理抗生素使用的假设性影响。2023年5月至2024年12月期间，共纳入125例伴有早期发热的ANP患者。91.2%（114/125）的患者接受了抗生素治疗，而最终仅23.2%（29/125）被确诊为IPN，基于常规培养的合理抗生素使用率为14.5%（17/117）。在我们的模拟模型中，如果以血浆mNGS结果指导治疗，估计合理抗生素使用率可提高至71.8%。血浆mNGS有助于快速识别病原体，并显示出改善ANP早期发热患者抗生素合理使用性的潜力。
items.abstract_en: Indiscriminate antibiotic use remains common in febrile patients with acute necrotizing pancreatitis (ANP), particularly during the early phase. Metagenomic next‑generation sequencing (mNGS) has shown diagnostic utility for infected pancreatic necrosis (IPN) and may offer a means to guide antimicrobial therapy. We aimed to explore whether mNGS could potentially improve the appropriateness of antibiotic use in ANP patients presenting with early fever. This prospective multicenter cohort study was conducted at five hospitals in China, enrolling ANP patients who developed fever within two weeks of symptom onset. Antibiotic susceptibility was defined per local microbiology laboratory reports. The hypothetical impact of mNGS on reducing inappropriate antibiotic use was evaluated through a retrospective simulation using predefined criteria from the BGI China antimicrobial drug usage card, as mNGS results were not disclosed to the treating teams during the actual clinical course. Between May 2023 and December 2024, 125 ANP patients with early fever were enrolled. Antibiotics were administered to 91.2% (114/125) of patients, whereas only 23.2% (29/125)were eventually confirmed to have IPN, and the rate of appropriate antibiotic use was 14.5% (17/117) based on conventional culture. In our simulated model, if therapy had been guided by plasma mNGS results, the estimated rate of appropriate antibiotic use could have increased to 71.8%. Plasma mNGS facilitates rapid pathogen identification and shows potential for improving antibiotic appropriateness in ANP patients with early fever.
items.summary_cn: 该前瞻性多中心队列研究纳入125例早期发热的急性坏死性胰腺炎（ANP）患者，发现尽管91.2%接受了抗生素治疗，仅23.2%最终确诊感染性胰腺坏死，基于常规培养的抗生素合理使用率仅14.5%；模拟模型显示若以血浆mNGS结果指导治疗，合理使用率可提升至71.8%。

items.summary_cn: 该论文标题涉及非增强CT影像组学联合临床特征预测重症急性胰腺炎继发脓毒症，属于重症急性胰腺炎诊治方向，与研究方向核心关注点（1）直接相关，但摘要缺失，无法提供具体发现总结。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎胰周坏死脓液的宏基因组图谱：病原生态、耐药基因谱及疾病相关微生物模式
items.title_en: Metagenomic landscape of peripancreatic necrotic pus in acute pancreatitis: pathogen ecology, resistance gene profiles, and disease-associated microbial patterns
items.abstract_cn: 目的 利用宏基因组二代测序（mNGS）刻画外科ICU患者腹腔脓液的宏基因组图谱，比较急性胰腺炎（AP）相关与非胰腺炎腹腔感染之间的病原体生态和耐药基因谱，并探讨胰腺炎相关微生物特征与持续性器官衰竭状态之间的关联。方法 共纳入115例在外科ICU接受腹腔穿刺引流的患者，分为三组：POF组（AP伴持续性器官衰竭，n = 35）、Non-POF组（AP不伴持续性器官衰竭，n = 49）和Non-AP组（非胰腺炎腹腔感染，n = 31）。采用mNGS分析脓液样本，以刻画病原体谱、抗菌药物耐药基因（ARG）携带情况及微生物群落结构。结果 与非AP感染相比，两个AP组均呈现出以ICU相关病原体为主的趋同微生物谱，包括屎肠球菌、肺炎克雷伯菌、鲍曼不动杆菌复合群和铜绿假单胞菌，并具有广泛的ARG检出谱。AP患者的ARG阳性率高于非AP对照组（69.0% vs. 45.2%；P = 0.029），其中β-内酰胺类耐药基因（包括碳青霉烯酶相关基因）检出频繁。采样时，POF组与Non-POF组之间的α多样性和β多样性无差异，而两个AP组均与Non-AP感染明显分离（P < 0.01）。在Non-AP脓液中富集的物种中，粪肠球菌在调整合并症负担、疾病严重程度、抗生素暴露和ICU暴露后仍与AP状态呈负相关（均P ≤ 0.006）。科水平随机森林模型对AP识别取得了探索性区分性能（AUC = 0.843）。结论 AP相关胰周脓液具有独特的微生物生态学特征，表现为群落多样性降低、ICU相关病原体占优势和广泛的ARG检出谱。该模式与AP状态相关，但在采样时与POF无关。当与基于培养的药敏试验和临床因素结合解读时，这些发现可能有助于补充抗菌药物风险评估和经验性治疗决策，但仍需在前瞻性多中心研究中加以验证。
items.abstract_en: Objective To characterize the metagenomic landscape of intra-abdominal pus from surgical ICU patients using metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS), compare pathogen ecology and resistance gene profiles between acute pancreatitis (AP)-associated and non-pancreatitis abdominal infection, and examine the association between pancreatitis-associated microbial features and persistent organ failure status. Methods A total of 115 patients undergoing abdominal paracentesis and drainage in a surgical ICU were stratified into three groups: the POF group (AP with persistent organ failure, n = 35), the Non-POF group (AP without persistent organ failure, n = 49), and the Non-AP group (non-pancreatitis intra-abdominal infection, n = 31). Pus samples were analyzed by mNGS to characterize pathogen profiles, antimicrobial resistance gene (ARG) carriage, and microbial community structure. Results Compared with Non-AP infections, both AP groups showed a convergent microbial profile dominated by ICU-associated pathogens, including Enterococcus faecium , Klebsiella pneumoniae , Acinetobacter baumannii complex, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa , with broad ARG detection profiles. ARG positivity was higher in AP patients than Non-AP controls (69.0% vs. 45.2%; P = 0.029), with frequent detection of Beta-lactam resistance genes, including carbapenemase-related genes. At sampling, alpha and beta diversity did not differ between POF and Non-POF groups, whereas both AP groups were clearly separated from Non-AP infections ( P < 0.01). Among species enriched in Non-AP pus, Enterococcus faecalis remained inversely associated with AP status after adjustment for comorbidity burden, disease severity, antibiotic exposure, and ICU exposure (all P ≤ 0.006). The family-level random forest model achieved exploratory discriminatory performance for AP identification (AUC = 0.843). Conclusion AP-associated peripancreatic pus harbored a distinct microbial ecological profile characterized by reduced community diversity, predominance of ICU-associated pathogens, and broad ARG detection profiles. This pattern was associated with AP status but not with POF at sampling. These findings may complement antimicrobial risk assessment and empirical treatment decisions when interpreted alongside culture-based susceptibility testing and clinical factors, but require validation in prospective multicenter studies.
items.summary_cn: 该研究通过mNGS分析急性胰腺炎相关胰周坏死脓液的微生物组，发现AP患者脓液以ICU相关病原体为主、ARG携带率更高（69.0% vs 45.2%），且微生物群落结构与Non-AP感染明显分离，但与持续性器官衰竭状态在采样时无显著关联。

items.title_cn: 胆道微生物群失调与ERCP后胰腺炎易感性相关
items.title_en: Biliary Microbiome Dysbiosis Is Associated with Susceptibility to Post-ERCP Pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn:
摘要

背景与目的 胰腺炎仍然是内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）后最常见的不良事件，然而目前的风险分层主要依赖于临床和操作因素。本研究旨在探讨基于胆汁的微生物组特征作为ERCP后胰腺炎易感性的非操作患者层面风险因素的潜在联系。

方法 我们对一个前瞻性单中心队列中接受ERCP的患者（n = 148）进行了ERCP后胰腺炎发生率的分析，这些患者在操作时收集了胆汁。使用16S rRNA测序进行微生物谱分析。在发生和未发生ERCP后胰腺炎（PEP）的患者之间评估了α多样性、β多样性、差异丰度分析和代谢通路分析。

结果 与未发生胰腺炎的患者相比，PEP患者表现出胆汁微生物多样性显著降低且组成不同。差异丰度分析在PEP组中鉴定出多个耗竭的菌属。功能谱分析揭示了与PEP相关的微生物代谢通路的广泛减少，主要涉及生物合成和中心代谢功能。ROC曲线分析表明，差异丰度的胆汁微生物可以区分PEP患者与未发生胰腺炎的患者。

讨论 发生PEP的患者具有独特且功能耗竭的胆汁微生物组。这些发现与先前在急性胰腺炎中观察到的肠道菌群失调相呼应，并提示胆汁微生物组可能代表与PEP易感性相关的生物学通路。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Background & Aims Pancreatitis remains the most common adverse event following endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP), yet current risk stratification relies primarily on clinical and procedural factors. The present study aims to examine bile-based microbiome signatures as a potential link between nonprocedure patient-level risk factor for pancreatitis susceptibility after ERCP. Methods We performed analysis for rates of post-ERCP pancreatitis of a prospective single center cohort of patients undergoing ERCP (n = 148) with bile collected at the time of the procedure. Microbial profiling was performed using 16S rRNA sequencing. Alpha diversity, beta diversity, differential abundance analyses, and metabolic pathway analysis were evaluated between patients with and without post-ERCP pancreatitis (PEP). Results Patients with PEP demonstrated significantly reduced biliary microbial diversity and distinct composition compared with those without pancreatitis. Differential abundance analysis identified multiple depleted genera in the PEP group. Functional profiling revealed broad reductions in microbial metabolic pathways associated with PEP predominantly involving biosynthetic and central metabolic functions. ROC curve analysis demonstrated that differentially abundant bile microbes can discriminate patients with PEP from those without pancreatitis. Discussion Patients who develop PEP harbor a distinct and functionally depleted biliary microbiome. These findings parallel prior observations of gut dysbiosis in acute pancreatitis and suggest that the biliary microbiome may represent a biologic pathway associated with PEP susceptibility.
items.summary_cn: 该前瞻性单中心队列研究发现，发生ERCP术后胰腺炎（PEP）的患者胆汁微生物多样性显著降低且组成不同，差异丰度分析显示PEP组多个菌属耗竭，功能分析提示与PEP相关的微生物代谢通路（主要涉及生物合成和中心代谢功能）广泛减少；ROC曲线分析表明差异丰度的胆汁微生物可区分PEP患者与非胰腺炎患者。

items.title_cn: 高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎早期院内甘油三酯清除轨迹及时间加权平均暴露：与疾病严重程度和胰腺坏死的关联
items.title_en: Early in-hospital triglyceride clearance trajectories and time-weighted mean exposure in hypertriglyceridemia-associated acute pancreatitis: associations with disease severity and pancreatic necrosis
items.abstract_cn: 背景 高甘油三酯血症相关急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）是一种临床上重要的急性胰腺炎亚型，与不良结局相关。既往评估主要依赖入院时或峰值甘油三酯（TG）水平，这可能无法捕捉院内早期TG清除动态或持续暴露强度。本研究探讨了TG清除轨迹和时间加权平均甘油三酯暴露（TWM-TG）与HTG-AP中重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）及胰腺坏死之间的关联。方法 本回顾性队列研究纳入526例HTG-AP患者。分析入院后7天内获得的系列TG测量值。采用潜在类别混合模型（LCMM）识别TG清除轨迹。使用梯形法则计算TG暴露曲线下面积，并以首次和末次TG测量之间的时间间隔进行标准化，从而得出TWM-TG。缺失数据采用链式方程多重插补处理。协变量采用Boruta算法筛选，随后进行10折交叉验证的LASSO回归和方差膨胀因子评估。在五个插补数据集中进行Firth logistic回归，并使用Rubin规则合并估计值。结果 识别出两种TG轨迹：快速下降组（n=430）和缓慢下降组（n=96）。缓慢下降组的SAP患者比例高于快速下降组（46.9% vs 11.9%）。经多变量调整后，缓慢下降TG轨迹（OR=6.44，95% CI：3.55–11.69，P < 0.001）和TWM-TG（OR=1.66，95% CI：1.33–2.08，P < 0.001）与SAP的更高风险相关，而最大TG与SAP无显著关联。对于胰腺坏死，仅TWM-TG仍保持显著关联（OR=1.27，95% CI：1.05–1.54，P = 0.016）。结论 TG清除轨迹和TWM-TG与HTG-AP的疾病严重程度相关，可能提供超越静态TG测量的补充信息。TWM-TG还与胰腺坏死相关，提示其与局部胰腺损伤有关。需要进一步的多中心验证以确认这些发现的普遍性和临床相关性。
items.abstract_en: Background Hypertriglyceridemia-associated acute pancreatitis (HTG-AP) is a clinically important subtype of acute pancreatitis associated with adverse outcomes. Previous assessments have mainly relied on admission or peak triglyceride (TG) levels, which may not capture early in-hospital TG clearance dynamics or sustained exposure intensity. This study investigated the associations of TG clearance trajectories and time-weighted mean triglyceride exposure (TWM-TG) with severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) and pancreatic necrosis in HTG-AP. Methods This retrospective cohort study included 526 patients with HTG-AP. Serial TG measurements obtained within 7 days after admission were analyzed. A latent class mixed model (LCMM) was used to identify TG clearance trajectories. The area under the TG exposure curve was calculated using the trapezoidal rule and standardized by the interval between the first and last TG measurements to derive TWM-TG. Missing data were handled using multiple imputation by chained equations. Covariates were selected using the Boruta algorithm, followed by LASSO regression with 10-fold cross-validation and variance inflation factor assessment. Firth logistic regression was performed in five imputed datasets, and estimates were pooled using Rubin's rules. Results Two TG trajectories were identified: a rapid-decline group ( n = 430 ) and a slow-decline group ( n = 96 ) . The proportion of patients with SAP was higher in the slow-decline group than in the rapid-decline group (46.9% vs 11.9%). After multivariable adjustment, a slow-decline TG trajectory (OR=6.44, 95% CI: 3.55–11.69, P < 0.001) and TWM-TG (OR=1.66, 95% CI: 1.33–2.08, P < 0.001) were associated with higher odds of SAP, whereas maximum TG was not significantly associated with SAP. For pancreatic necrosis, only TWM-TG remained significantly associated (OR=1.27, 95% CI: 1.05–1.54, P = 0.016). Conclusion TG clearance trajectories and TWM-TG were associated with disease severity in HTG-AP and may provide supplementary information beyond static TG measurements. TWM-TG was also associated with pancreatic necrosis, suggesting relevance to local pancreatic injury. Further multicenter validation is warranted to confirm the generalizability and clinical relevance of these findings.
items.summary_cn: 在HTG-AP患者中识别出快速下降和缓慢下降两种TG清除轨迹，缓慢下降轨迹及时间加权平均TG暴露（TWM-TG）与重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）风险升高相关，而最大TG值与SAP无显著关联；仅TWM-TG与胰腺坏死显著相关。

items.title_cn: 导丝直径对胆管插管结果的影响：0.025英寸与0.035英寸导丝的前瞻性随机比较
items.title_en: Impact of guidewire caliber on biliary cannulation outcomes: a prospective randomized comparison of 0.025-inch and 0.035-inch guidewires
items.abstract_cn: 背景与目的：导丝辅助胆管插管是内镜逆行胰胆管造影术（ERCP）的标准技术。导丝直径是否影响插管成功率或ERCP术后胰腺炎（PEP）仍不确定。我们评估了0.025英寸导丝在完整乳头初次胆管插管中是否非劣效于0.035英寸导丝。患者与方法：在这项前瞻性、单盲、随机非劣效性试验中，130例完整乳头患者按1：1随机分配至使用0.025英寸或0.035英寸导丝进行导丝引导插管。主要结局是在达到ESGE/SADE困难插管标准之前实现成功胆管插管，这比最终插管成功更为严格，最终插管成功另行记录。预设的亚组分析按内镜医师经验比较结局。结果：0.025英寸导丝组初次插管成功率为47.7%（31/65），0.035英寸导丝组为43.1%（28/65），风险差为+4.6%（95% CI −12.2至+21.1；p = 0.73），证实非劣效性。两组最终插管成功率均为96.9%（63/65）。插管时间（335 vs. 420秒；p = 0.74）、PEP发生率（9.2% vs. 16.9%；p = 0.30）和插管失败率（3.1% vs. 3.1%）相当。经验丰富的内镜医师使用0.025英寸导丝的初次插管成功率高于学员（67.9% vs. 32.4%；p = 0.006），插管时间更短（178 vs. 889秒；p = 0.0002），但在任一经验分层内，两种导丝均无优劣之分，且导丝与经验的交互作用不显著（p = 0.16）。结论：0.025英寸导丝在初次胆管插管中非劣效于0.035英寸导丝。操作者经验而非导丝直径是初次插管成功的主要决定因素。我们的数据提示较细导丝在经验丰富者手中可能具有特定优势，但尚未确立。
items.abstract_en: Background and aim Guidewire-assisted biliary cannulation is the standard technique for endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP). Whether guidewire caliber influences cannulation success or post-ERCP pancreatitis (PEP) remains uncertain. We evaluated whether the 0.025-inch guidewire is non-inferior to the 0.035-inch guidewire for primary biliary cannulation of the intact papilla.Patients and methods In this prospective, single-blind, randomized non-inferiority trial, 130 patients with an intact papilla were randomized 1:1 to wire-guided cannulation with a 0.025-inch or 0.035-inch guidewire. The primary outcome was successful biliary cannulation achieved before the ESGE/SADE criteria for difficult cannulation were met, a stricter endpoint than final cannulation success, which was recorded separately. A planned subgroup analysis compared outcomes by endoscopist experience.Results Primary cannulation success was 47.7% (31/65) with the 0.025-inch wire and 43.1% (28/65) with the 0.035-inch wire, a risk difference of +4.6% (95% CI −12.2 to +21.1; p = 0.73), confirming non-inferiority. Final cannulation success was 96.9% (63/65) in both groups. Cannulation time (335 vs. 420 s; p = 0.74), PEP rate (9.2% vs. 16.9%; p = 0.30), and failed cannulation (3.1% vs. 3.1%) were comparable. Experienced endoscopists achieved higher primary cannulation success with the 0.025-inch wire than fellows (67.9% vs. 32.4%; p = 0.006) and shorter cannulation times (178 vs. 889 s; p = 0.0002), but neither wire was superior within either experience stratum and the wire-by-experience interaction was not significant (p = 0.16).Conclusions The 0.025-inch guidewire is non-inferior to the 0.035-inch guidewire for primary biliary cannulation. Operator experience, not guidewire caliber, was the dominant determinant of primary cannulation success. A specific advantage of the thinner wire in experienced hands is suggested by our data but not established.
items.summary_cn: 在完整乳头初次胆管插管中，0.025英寸导丝对0.035英寸导丝具有非劣效性，两组最终插管成功率均为96.9%，插管时间、PEP发生率及插管失败率相当。操作者经验而非导丝口径是初次插管成功的主要决定因素，经验丰富的内镜医师使用0.025英寸导丝时初次插管成功率更高、插管时间更短。

items.title_cn: 一次性数字单人操作胆道镜的有效性和安全性：一项非劣效性、多中心、随机、开放标签、盲法终点试验
items.title_en: Efficacy and safety of disposable digital single-operator cholangioscopy: A noninferiority, multicenter, randomized, open-label, blinded endpoint trial
items.abstract_cn: 背景：胆道镜检查是微创胆道手术的重要工具，图像质量对胆道病变的诊断和治疗起着至关重要的作用。目前，数字胆道镜和纤维胆道镜均广泛应用于临床。然而，从临床诊断需求的角度来看，很少有头对头研究对这两种设备进行比较。目的：评估一次性数字单人操作胆道镜（DSOC）在诊断和治疗操作中的疗效和安全性。方法：2022年1月至2022年12月共纳入114名受试者。受试者按1：1的比例随机分配至试验组和对照组。试验组使用一次性DSOC，对照组使用可重复使用纤维单人操作胆道镜（FSOC）。主要结局通过评估满足临床诊断需求的图像质量合格率来衡量。次要结局通过基于评分的设备性能来评估。结果：DSOC组满足临床诊断需求的图像质量合格率为98.28%，FSOC组为98.21%（率差：0.0615%；95%置信区间：-7.4994%至7.8518%）。DSOC组92.9%的图像被评为优秀，而FSOC组为16.07%（P < 0.05）。DSOC在插入和退出的顺畅性，以及器械通道的密封性和弯曲部的灵活性方面表现更好。此外，在DSOC组中，附件能够与器械通道紧密配合以完成操作（P < 0.05）。DSOC组报告的不良事件总发生率为46.6%（27/58），而FSOC组为51.8%（29/56）（P > 0.05）。结论：DSOC在图像质量、顺畅性、密封性和灵活性方面显著优于FSOC。数字胆道镜代表了微创胆道手术的发展趋势。
items.abstract_en: BACKGROUNDCholangioscopy is an important tool used for minimally invasive biliary surgery, and image quality plays a crucial role in the diagnosis and treatment of biliary lesions.Currently, both digital cholangioscopy and fiberoptic cholangioscopy are widely used in clinical settings.However, from the perspective of clinical diagnostic requirements, few head-to-head studies have compared the two devices. AIMTo evaluate the efficacy and safety of disposable digital single-operator cholangioscopy (DSOC) in terms of diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. METHODSA total of 114 participants were enrolled from January 2022 to December 2022.The participants were randomized at a ratio of 1:1 to the test and control groups.Disposable DSOCs were employed in the test group, whereas reusable fiberoptic single-operator cholangioscopies (FSOCs) were used in the control group.The primary outcome was measured by assessing the image quality compliance rate for clinical diagnostic requirements.The secondary outcome was assessed by score-based device performance. RESULTSThe image quality compliance rates for clinical diagnostic requirements were observed to be 98.28% in the DSOC group, and 98.21% in the FSOC group (rate difference: 0.0615%; 95% confidence interval: -7.4994% to 7.8518%).92.9% of the images were graded as excellent in the DSOC group, whereas 16.07% in the FSOC group (P < 0.05).DSOC performed better in terms of the smoothness of insertion and withdrawal, as well 5 / 30 as the sealability of the instrument channel and flexibility of the bending section.Additionally, the accessory could cooperate closely with the instrument channel to complete the procedure in the DSOC group (P < 0.05).The overall rate of reported adverse events was 46.6% (27/58) in the DSOC group compared with 51.8% (29/56) in the FSOC group (P > 0.05).CONCLUSION DSOC was significantly superior to FSOC in terms of image quality, smoothness, sealability and flexibility.Digital cholangioscopy represents a growing trend in minimally invasive biliary surgery.
items.summary_cn: 在114例随机对照试验中，一次性数字单人操作胆道镜（DSOC）在临床诊断所需的图像质量合格率上不劣于可重复使用光纤胆道镜（FSOC）（98.28% vs 98.21%），且DSOC在图像优良率、插入退出顺畅性、器械通道密封性和弯曲部灵活性方面表现更优，两组不良事件发生率无显著差异。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
